mechanism_narrative: Sustained contraction in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES reflects a broad withdrawal from commuting and out-of-home activity; this depresses weekday retail footfall, so RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks will be lower than its last four-week mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is greater than or equal to its last 28-day mean despite TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remaining at or below t-0w levels.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week fall in TRANSIT greater than 7 points signals a policy-driven tightening of mobility restrictions; the implementation lag suppresses retail-and-recreation, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls more than 7 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell from -58.4 at t-1w to -66.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: Following a TRANSIT weekly drop greater than 7 points, RETAIL_REC next 14-day mean is not lower than its prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The joint pattern of PARKS below -30 and RESIDENTIAL above 15 indicates enforced stay-at-home behavior; this suppresses discretionary trips, so RETAIL_REC declines more over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: When PARKS < -30 and RESIDENTIAL > 15 jointly occur, RETAIL_REC next 14-day mean is greater than or equal to its prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: A deepening decline in GROCERY_PHARM from -2.1 to -11.1 signals precautionary avoidance of even essential outings; this behavioral caution spills over to discretionary retail, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell from -2.1 at t-3w to -11.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 7-day mean is not lower than its last 7-day mean when GROCERY_PHARM remains at or below -10.

mechanism_narrative: Under a stage-4 lockdown regime, with WORKPLACES below -30 and RESIDENTIAL above 17, non-essential retail is legally restricted; RETAIL_REC will remain below its last four-week mean over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: During a stage-4 lockdown regime (WORKPLACES < -30 and RESIDENTIAL > 17), RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is greater than or equal to its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The PARKS decline to -37.9 is amplified by winter weather rather than policy alone; as seasonal conditions ease and PARKS recovers above -25, outdoor trips and retail footfall rebound, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: PARKS rises above -25 within two weeks but RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean remains below its last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: A joint collapse in GROCERY_PHARM below -10 and TRANSIT below -60 indicates simultaneous restriction of essential trips and commuting; this broad mobility contraction cuts retail-and-recreation traffic, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next week.
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM < -10 and TRANSIT < -60 jointly occur, RETAIL_REC next 7-day mean is not lower than its last 7-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility above 15 reflects a persistent shift of activity into the home; because home-based consumption substitutes for in-person retail, RETAIL_REC will stay below its last four-week mean over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from 11.6 at t-3w to 17.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 14-day mean is not lower than its last 14-day mean while RESIDENTIAL remains above 15.
